nodes.title: SG-2.2 · Validated object and world content schema
nodes.body:
Context: game/src has a manifest zod schema but object and world content is loaded without a runtime schema, and the-boys-room lives in game/content/worlds. Desired behavior: a zod object/world schema covering position, scale, layer, interaction bounds, actions, visibility conditions and persistent-state fields, with the-boys-room content adapted to it under game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room. Expected result: loadWorld returns schema-validated content from the new location. Why: future AI cycles add objects through content only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an object with position, scale, layer, interactionBounds, actions, visibleWhen and persistentState, when parsed by the schema, then it succeeds
- Given invalid object content, when parsed, then a path-named error is returned without throwing
- Given the-boys-room under src/content/worlds, when loadWorld runs, then it loads and passes validateWorld


## Scope
- In scope: game/src content schema
- In scope: move and adapt the-boys-room content
- In scope: loader and frontend glob path
- In scope: scene view visibility and persistent state
- Out of scope: Phaser rendering
- Out of scope: asset art
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: existing manifest schema
- Preserve: existing action ids and events
- Preserve: bookshelf secret door flag behavior


## Technical constraints
- zod already a dependency of game/
- Content stays YAML


## Definition of done
- All three requirements verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Zod schemas for objects, scenes and worlds
nodes.body:
Context: no runtime schema exists for object content. Desired behavior: objectSchema covers id, name, description, asset, position, scale, layer, interactionBounds, actions, visibleWhen conditions and persistentState; scene and world schemas wrap it. - Out of scope: loader wiring
- Preserve: manifest schema untouched


## Technical constraints

nodes.title: REQ · the-boys-room content lives in src/content/worlds and is schema-validated on load
nodes.body:
Context: content is at game/content/worlds/the-boys-room, read by loader.ts and by the frontend import.meta.glob. Desired behavior: files move to game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room with each object given asset, position, scale, layer, interactionBounds; loadWorld validates via schema. Expected result: loadWorld on the new dir succeeds, malformed scenes fail with a path-named error. Why: content separated from engine in the target structure.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the new directory, when loadWorld runs, then six bedroom objects load each with a layer and position
- Given a scene object lacking position, when loadWorld runs, then it throws naming the field path
- Given the old game/content directory, then it no longer exists


## Scope
- In scope: git mv content to src/content/worlds
- In scope: scene yaml fields
- In scope: loadWorld validation
- In scope: frontend glob path
- Out of scope: new art
- Preserve: action ids, texts, flags, dialogue


## Technical constraints
- Object ids unchanged: bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window, door


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Content relocated and validated


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Scene view honors visibility conditions and persistent state
nodes.body:
Context: getSceneView only supports openWhenFlag. Desired behavior: objects with visibleWhen conditions that fail are omitted; open derives from persistentState.flag (stored in GameState.flags, which persistence already saves) with openWhenFlag fallback; validateWorld checks the flags referenced. Expected result: the bookshelf stays open after the flag is set. Why: persistent object states.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given visibleWhen flag false, when getSceneView runs, then the object is absent
- Given persistentState flag true in state, when getSceneView runs, then open is true
- Given persistentState references an undeclared flag, when validateWorld runs, then 'unknown flag' error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: src/engine/scene.ts
- In scope: src/content/loader.ts validateWorld
- In scope: src/state/types.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser
- Preserve: openWhenFlag behavior
- Preserve: persistence.ts


## Technical constraints
- Reuse evaluateAll


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Behavior covered by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Define conditionSchema as union of {flag:string, equals:boolean optional} and {hasItem:string}; actionSchema with id enum inspect|push|search|leave, label string, conditions optional array, events array of z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) objects with a string type field; objectSchema with id, name, description, asset string, position {x,y numbers}, scale number positive default 1, layer enum background|furniture|objects|characters|effects|ui, interactionBounds boundsSchema imported from ../assets/manifest/schema optional, actions array, visibleWhen conditionSchema array optional, persistentState {flag string, initial boolean optional} optional, openWhenFlag string optional.

Define sceneSchema (id, title, openingDialogue optional, dialogue array of records, objects array of objectSchema) and worldSchema (id, title, startScene, scenes string array, characters array of {id,name}, flags string array). Export parseWorldContent(kind: 'scene'|'world', input: unknown) returning {ok:true,data}|{ok:false,errors:{path,message}[]} via safeParse, joining issue.path with '.'.
steps.code: export function parseWorldContent(kind, input) { const r = (kind==='scene'?sceneSchema:worldSchema).safeParse(input); ... }
steps.expected: Invalid input returns errors, never throws
